correctness.rationale: The three seven-column four-row capacities are finite natural complexes. From full legal faces, exact greedy acyclic discrete Morse matching is verified over every face-poset cover, with critical cells (0:1,4:3,5:18), (0:1,3:1,4:36,5:92), (0:1,3:2,4:95,5:150). The complete signed Morse boundary complexes satisfy d4*d5=0 and admit exact integer unit pivot ranks (3), (1,35), (2,93), leaving respectively 15,57,57 fifth-dimensional cells plus a vertex. No 1/2 cells, and cancellation of unit-incidence adjacent cells over Z yields wedges of S5; all full finite cases are exhaustive, not sampled. Independently implemented entire face generation, Hasse acyclicity, Morse reduction and integer pivots in local script chessboard_independent_1804.py, matching 8835,15933,18873 faces and quoted counts. Inspected actual verifier source verify_chessboard.py.
